indexes.name: idx_tracker_history_queue_ready
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX idx_tracker_history_queue_ready ON public.tracker_historical_display_queue USING btree (next_attempt_at, enqueued_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'processing'::text]))

policies.name: tracker_floor_alerts_select_ops
policies.using_expression:
(is_club_tracker(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), club_id) OR is_club_floor(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), club_id) OR is_club_owner(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), club_id) OR is_club_admin(( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid), club_id) OR ((reported_by = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ((assignment_id IS NULL) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM dealer_assignments da
  WHERE ((da.id = tracker_floor_alerts.assignment_id) AND (da.status = 'assigned'::text) AND (da.released_at IS NULL)))))))

triggers.name: trg_guard_tracker_blind_snapshot_insert

triggers.name: trg_guard_tracker_blind_snapshot_update

triggers.name: trg_tracker_enqueue_historical_display
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tracker_enqueue_historical_display AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON tournament_hands FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION tracker_enqueue_historical_display_trigger()

triggers.name: trg_tracker_hand_action_source_revision

triggers.name: trg_tracker_hand_player_source_revision

triggers.name: trg_tracker_hand_source_revision
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_tracker_hand_source_revision BEFORE UPDATE OF button_seat, community_cards, pot_size, side_pots, status, is_voided, tracker_level_id, tracker_level_number, tracker_small_blind, tracker_big_blind, tracker_bba, tracker_is_break, tracker_blind_evidence ON tournament_hands FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION tracker_bump_hand_source_revision()
